notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Aethergeode Miner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.
